title: Collatz: finite triadic height certificate and direct closure attacks
body:
## Checkpoint 16 — 23 November 2026

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** The triadic route previously charged a numerator-height budget at each denominator drop. This checkpoint proves a single weighted-potential bound that pays for every drop and yields a complete finite convergence certificate in Lean. It removes the multiplication of numerator height by denominator exponent. Constructing a successful candidate for every positive input remains the central unresolved step.

## 1. A finite triadic certificate with an additive height cost

Use the literal shortcut map, dividing even inputs by two and sending odd inputs to (3n+1)/2. For one fixed positive integer n, signed numerator a, and nonnegative denominator exponent r, set

```text
F(r) = product_(0 <= j < r) (1+3^j)
B = n * max(1,abs(a)) * F(r)
E = bitlength(B)
H = 9*E+1.
```

If the actual paired trajectory starting at (n,a,r) passes its first H complementary-parity tests, the original orbit reaches 1 by H.

The formal theorem is `CollatzTriadicBudget.finite_triadic_height_certificate`. It includes the computed horizon, signed numerators, denominator drops, the integral tie, entry at zero, and the remaining zero tail. Its premise is finite compatibility; no all-time compatibility, presumed drift, cycle exclusion, or universal candidate-existence premise supplies the conclusion.

The new potential is

```text
P = x * abs(w) * F(r).
```

An original odd nonterminal step contracts P by 5/6. An original even step at positive denominator exponent contracts it by at least 1/4, including numerator growth and sign changes. At exponent zero the only tie is w=1, followed by a contraction if compatibility continues. Eight nonzero nonterminal steps strictly halve the integer potential. At zero entry the same budget pays for the finite all-odd divisibility tail.

The written estimate
`log_2 F(r) = r(r-1)log_2(3)/2 + O(1)`
therefore gives a sufficient horizon

```text
O(log n + log max(1,abs(a)) + r^2).
```

The prior PR178 horizon is
`8 bl(n)+(9r+8) bl(max(1,abs(a),3^r))+2`.
The numerator-height cost is now additive. Either certificate may be used when it is shorter; no pointwise improvement for every parameter tuple is claimed.

[Complete written proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/TRIADIC_AMORTIZED_BUDGET.md) · [Lean source](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/lean/TriadicAmortizedBudget.lean) · [Formal scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/LEAN_SCOPE.md)

### The precise construction still needed

For the actual first K shortcut bits e_i, put

```text
D_0 = 0
D_(i+1) = 3^(1-e_i)*D_i + (1-e_i)*2^i
b_K = number of even inputs.
```

It suffices to construct one a,r,K with

```text
K >= 9*bl(n*max(1,abs(a))*F(r))+1
2^K divides 3^b_K*a + 3^r*D_K.
```

The complete congruence forces all preceding complementary parities by inverting the same affine word over odd-denominator rationals. **This congruence consumer is independently reviewed written mathematics; the Lean capstone takes the finite literal compatibility tests.** The logarithmic asymptotic is also written.

The [standalone two-carry construction question](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/TWO_CARRY_CONSTRUCTION_QUESTION.txt) includes a second carry that fixes the original n and selects its actual word entirely in finite arithmetic. A universal proof would settle full convergence. It is a handoff target, not a proved or independently weaker lemma.

The attempt pursued coupled carries, rational reconstruction and Monks's polynomial q-analog conjugacy. The latter's polynomial degree is exactly the first-hit clock when convergence is known. No independent polynomiality or own-height small-residue theorem was obtained.

## 2. An all-depth optimizer need not have a balanced word

PR182's common pressure maximum gives an immediate all-ancestor coefficient comparison at every subsequent target. We tested whether extremal-word machinery could turn that comparison into a contradiction.

There is an exact obstruction: 31 is the unique coefficient maximizer among **every positive odd unit ancestor at every depth** of each target in

```text
31 -> 47 -> 71 -> 107 -> 161 -> 121 -> 91.
```

The shortcut word `11111010` is unbalanced. Every source at least 32 is excluded at all depths by the universal coefficient bound gamma(n,q)<=q/n and the seven strict cutoffs. At the last target,
`91/32 = 728/256 < 729/256`.
Ten explicit smaller-source trajectories exhaust the remaining positive odd unit sources. The trajectory from 31 reaches one and has no repeated visit.

A separate fixed-target control shows that balancing gaps (1,2,3) to (2,2,2) changes the integer source 11 into 283/27. Ordinary integrality cannot be discarded during the optimization.

This convergent finite example refutes the proposed automatic balance implication. It does **not** refute a property that truly requires an infinite escaping optimal ray. The pressure comparison itself is credited to the existing root identity.

[Exact proof and controls](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/OPTIMAL_ANCESTOR_BALANCE.md)

## 3. Literature attacks with the actual source law and full denominator retained

The parallel entropy attack examined Hochman's inverse entropy statements and Hochman–Shmerkin's separate-invariance/scenery machinery against the actual graph-directed boundary law. Its residual measure still depends on the ordinary endpoint. No independent convolution or separate multiplication invariance was established.

Two explicitly credited consequences of earlier retracing identities were reconstructed: high-profile mass tends to one uniformly over the moving inverse clock, and a reference assigning the retracing word exponentially small mass incurs linear relative entropy. Neither is the missing critical collision bound.

The cycle attack tested Tao's additive-cube discussion, affine-walk cutoff and extremal-word results against the unchanged complete numerical denominator. No zero-fibre estimate strong enough to exclude all rotations of a primitive cycle was obtained. The notes retain the exact theorem hypotheses and source-access limitations.

[Actual-boundary attempt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/BOUNDARY_RIGIDITY_ATTEMPT.md) · [Complete-cycle literature attempt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/FULL_CYCLE_LITERATURE_ATTEMPT.md) · [Pinned sources](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fb402404deb810bd8e32e596993739bb5a6967d1/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/triadic-height/SOURCES.json)

- Fresh strict compilation of the unchanged pinned PR178 dependency, new module and audit with Lean 4.34.1/compiler `5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52`; Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`.
- All **22 new theorem declarations and four definitions** audited. These counts describe the proof inventory, not 22 separate advances. Axiom union: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only; no admissions, custom mathematical axioms or native proof shortcuts.
- Independent written reconstruction covers the signed potential, zero entry, zero tail and endpoint-congruence consumer; a separate agent freshly rebuilt the final formal bytes.
- A further independent integration review reconstructs both carry implications, the converse from convergence and the optimizer's complete source coverage.
- Exact controls include seven reconstructed known certificates, 22 altered-candidate/carry/denominator/stale-horizon rejections, and 95,540 compatible signed states. These checks are not universal candidate construction.
- All three new arithmetic checkers passed normally and with Python optimization, producing identical output.
- Source refresh covers seven active PR heads against checkpoint 15's larger metadata inventory; the advancing scientific heads were PR178, PR180 and PR182. Sixteen selected upstream files are bound by exact commit, blob and SHA-256.
- On the **exact published head above**, all five required repository gate commands passed in a clean complete **637-file checkout**. All 26 delivery manifest bindings and eight executed-source hashes matched the fetched publication.
- No historical proof corpus or expensive prior census was rerun.
